title: Checking Year 3 Programme
description: The entrance check of the baccalaureate year: everything Year 3 left you and the final year takes for granted - the past simple against the present perfect and the past perfect, reported speech in full (tense backshift, pronouns and possessives, time and place markers, say and tell, reported questions, orders and advice), word building (nouns made from verbs and adjectives, the prefixes re-, over-, mis-, well-, un-, dis-, il- and im-, adjectives in -ed and in -ing), the words that are confused for looking alike (advice and advise, rise, raise and arise, require, acquire, request and inquire), the linkers of contrast, consequence, reason and alternative, lexical fields, and writing as a process with its six steps, its correction code (V, G, S, P, C, W.L, W.O. and the tick) and the development of telegraphic notes into full sentences
